fullPassage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.

questions.passage: The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents ①<u>made</u> the gold miners arriving to Qukkon ②<u>came</u> to life. This ③<u>reminded</u> me of when I ④<u>lived</u> in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 동사원형: came → come.
det.analysis: ✅ ①made: 사역동사 과거형, 적절. ❌ ②came: make + O + V(원형) → come이 맞음. came(과거형)은 틀림. ✅ ③reminded: remind A of B, 적절. ✅ ④lived: when절 과거형, 적절.
det.tip: 사역동사 make + O + 동사원형. make ~ come to life = ~을 실감나게 만들다.

questions.passage: Because of this, I'm ①<u>wondering</u> if there are volunteer guide positions ②<u>available</u> for this exhibition. I can share my experiences ③<u>worked</u> in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I ④<u>would be</u> thankful if you could tell me about the availability.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: experiences를 수식하는 현재분사(능동): worked → working.
det.analysis: ✅ ①wondering: 현재진행형, 적절. ✅ ②available: positions를 후치수식하는 형용사, 적절. ❌ ③worked: experiences를 수식 → 능동적 의미이므로 현재분사 working이 맞음. ✅ ④would be: 가정법, 적절.
det.tip: 현재분사(V-ing)의 후치수식: experiences working = 일한 경험. 능동이면 -ing.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's ①<u>exhibition</u> about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners ②<u>arrived</u> to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of ③<u>when</u> I lived in Qukkon. I'm wondering ④<u>if</u> there are volunteer guide positions available.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: miners를 수식하는 현재분사(능동): arrived → arriving.
det.analysis: ✅ ①exhibition: 명사, 적절. ❌ ②arrived: miners를 능동적으로 수식 → 현재분사 arriving이 맞음. 금광채굴꾼들이 '도착하는' 것이므로 능동. ✅ ③when: 시간 관계부사, 적절. ✅ ④if: 간접의문문(~인지), 적절.
det.tip: 현재분사 vs 과거분사: 수식받는 명사가 동작의 주체(능동)이면 -ing, 대상(수동)이면 -ed.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection ①<u>of</u> pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and ②<u>worked</u> in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there ③<u>are</u> volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. Again, I would be thankful if you ④<u>can</u> tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 가정법: would be ~ if + 주어 + could(과거형). can → could.
det.analysis: ✅ ①of: 전치사, collection of ~. ✅ ②worked: 과거형, lived와 병렬. ✅ ③are: 현재 시점에서 존재 여부를 물음, 적절. ❌ ④can: 'would be thankful if ~' 가정법 → if절에 과거형 could가 와야 함.
det.tip: 가정법 과거: would + V ~ if + S + 과거동사. would be thankful if you could ~.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This ①<u>reminded</u> me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are ②<u>volunteer</u> guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the ③<u>extreme</u> cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be ④<u>ungrateful</u> if you could tell me about the availability.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 알려주시면 감사하겠다(thankful)는 맥락. ungrateful(감사하지 않는)은 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①reminded: 상기시키다, 적절. ✅ ②volunteer: 자원봉사, 적절. ✅ ③extreme: 극심한, 적절. ❌ ④ungrateful: 원문은 thankful(감사하는). '감사하지 않는'은 요청하는 맥락과 정반대.
det.tip: thankful(감사하는) = grateful ↔ ungrateful(감사하지 않는). 접두사 un-이 반의어를 만듦.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and ①<u>historical</u> documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining ②<u>industry</u>. I can share my experiences working in the ③<u>moderate</u> cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the ④<u>availability</u> of volunteer positions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: Qukkon의 극심한(extreme) 추위에서 일한 경험. moderate(온건한)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①historical: 역사적인, 적절. ✅ ②industry: 산업, 적절. ❌ ③moderate: 원문은 extreme. 극심한 추위에서 일한 경험을 공유하겠다는 맥락이므로 '온건한'은 부적절. ✅ ④availability: 가능성, 적절.
det.tip: extreme(극심한) ↔ moderate(온건한, 적당한). 추위의 극심함이 경험의 가치를 높임.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '필자는 과거에 Qukkon에서 광업에 종사한 적이 있다.'

det.korean: 'when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry' — Qukkon에서 광업에 종사했음.
det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문에 'lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry'라고 명시.
det.tip: mining industry = 광업. lived and worked = 거주하며 일했다.

questions.passage: Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '필자는 유급 안내원 자리를 찾고 있다.'

det.korean: 'volunteer guide positions' — 유급이 아니라 자원봉사 안내원 자리를 찾고 있다. F.
det.analysis: ❌ F: volunteer = 자원봉사자. 유급(paid)이 아님.
det.tip: volunteer = 자원봉사의, 무급의 ↔ paid = 유급의.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오: '전시회에는 그림, 도구, 역사적 문서가 포함되어 있었다.'

det.korean: 'The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents' — 그림, 도구, 역사적 문서로 구성.
det.analysis: ✅ T: pictures(그림), tools(도구), historical documents(역사적 문서) 세 가지 명시.
det.tip: collection of A, B, and C = A, B, C의 모음/수집품.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

The exhibition made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon ______. It felt as if they were right in front of me.

det.korean: 전시회가 금광 채굴꾼들을 생생하게 만들었다(come alive).
det.analysis: ✅ ④come alive: come to life와 동의. 실감나게 되다. ❌ ①disappear gradually: 점차 사라지다 — 반대. ❌ ②seem exaggerated: 과장되어 보이다 — 문맥 불일치. ❌ ③become forgotten: 잊히다 — 반대.
det.tip: come to life = come alive = 생생해지다, 실감나게 되다.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

The writer wants to become a volunteer guide because he can ______ based on his past life in Qukkon.
ch: share firsthand knowledge of gold mining
display his collection of historical artifacts
teach visitors how to survive in cold weather
organize a new exhibition about the Gold Rush

det.korean: 필자는 Qukkon에서 광업 경험이 있어 직접 체험한 지식을 공유할 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①share firsthand knowledge: 직접 경험한 지식 공유 — 'share my experiences working in the mining industry'. ❌ ②display collection: 수집품 전시는 필자가 아닌 재단의 역할. ❌ ③teach survival: 생존법 교육 언급 없음. ❌ ④organize exhibition: 전시 조직 언급 없음.
det.tip: firsthand = 직접 체험한. share experiences = 경험을 공유하다.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 필자는 Lambsford History Foundation에서 근무하고 있다.
전시회는 Qukkon의 기후 변화에 관한 것이다.
필자는 전시회의 자원봉사 안내원이 되고 싶어 한다.

det.korean: 'I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available' — 자원봉사 안내원 지원 희망.
det.analysis: ✅ ③자원봉사 안내원 희망: volunteer guide positions available 질문 → 지원 의사. ❌ ①근무: 방문(visited)했을 뿐 근무 언급 없음. ❌ ②기후 변화: Gold Rush에 관한 전시회. ❌ ④현재 거주: 과거형 lived(과거에 살았음).
det.tip: visited(방문했다) ≠ worked at(근무했다). lived(과거에 살았다) ≠ live(현재 산다).

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 전시회의 수집품에는 금광 채굴꾼들의 일기가 포함되어 있다.
필자는 Qukkon의 극심한 추위 속에서 일한 경험이 있다.

det.korean: 'pictures, tools, and historical documents' — 일기(diaries)는 언급되지 않았다.
det.analysis: ❌ ②일기 포함: pictures(그림), tools(도구), historical documents(역사적 문서)만 언급. diaries(일기)는 없음. ✅ ①전시회 개최: Foundation's exhibition → 재단이 개최. ✅ ③광업 종사: worked in the mining industry. ✅ ④극심한 추위: extreme cold of Qukkon.
det.tip: historical documents(역사적 문서) ≠ diaries(일기). 세부 정보의 변형에 주의.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. ①The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. ②This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. ③Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. ④I can share my experiences worked in the extreme cold of Qukkon.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 어법상 틀린 부분이 포함된 문장은?

det.korean: ④번: experiences를 수식하는 현재분사(능동) — worked → working.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: make + O + V(원형), 현재분사 arriving. ✅ ②: reminded A of B, when절. ✅ ③: wondering if(간접의문문), available(후치수식). ❌ ④: experiences + worked → working(현재분사, 능동)이 맞음.
det.tip: experiences working in ~: ~에서 일한 경험. 현재분사가 명사를 후치수식.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's __________ about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 쓰시오.

det.korean: Lambsford History Foundation의 전시회를 방문했다.
det.analysis: exhibition: 전시회. Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush.
det.tip: exhibition = display = show. 전시회를 뜻하는 동의어.

questions.passage: Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the __________(available) of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

det.korean: the + 명사 자리: available(형용사) → availability(명사).
det.analysis: availability: the __________ of → 관사 the + 전치사 of 사이이므로 명사형 필요. available → availability.
det.tip: available(형용사: 이용 가능한) → availability(명사: 가능성, 이용 가능 여부).

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, __________. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열한 것은?

Because of this, I'm wondering if there are __________.

[available / volunteer / guide / for / positions / this exhibition]
ch: volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition
available volunteer guide positions for this exhibition
volunteer positions guide available for this exhibition
guide volunteer positions available this exhibition for

det.korean: 자원봉사 안내원 자리가 이 전시회에 이용 가능한.
det.analysis: ✅ ①volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition: 원문 그대로. volunteer guide(자원봉사 안내원) + positions(직책) + available(형용사 후치수식) + for this exhibition(전치사구). ❌ ②available이 앞에 오면 후치수식 구조가 깨짐. ❌ ③guide 위치 오류. ❌ ④어순 파괴.
det.tip: 형용사 후치수식: positions available = 이용 가능한 자리. -able/-ible 형용사는 명사 뒤에서 수식 가능.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: Qukkon Gold Rush의 역사적 의의와 경제적 영향
전시회에서 자원봉사 안내원으로 활동하고 싶다는 지원 의사
Lambsford History Foundation의 설립 목적과 운영 방식
극심한 추위 속에서의 광업 생활에 대한 회고

det.korean: 필자는 전시회를 보고 과거 경험을 떠올려 자원봉사 안내원 지원 의사를 밝히고 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②지원 의사: 글의 핵심 = 전시회 방문 → 과거 경험 상기 → 자원봉사 안내원 지원. ❌ ①역사적 의의: 배경 정보일 뿐 주제 아님. ❌ ③재단 운영: 언급 없음. ❌ ④회고: 수단(경험 공유)이지 목적이 아님.
det.tip: 주제 = 글쓴이의 궁극적 의도. wondering if ~ available + would be thankful if ~ = 지원 의사.

questions.passage: I recently visited the Lambsford History Foundation's exhibition about the Qukkon Gold Rush. The collection of pictures, tools, and historical documents made the gold miners arriving to Qukkon come to life. This reminded me of when I lived in Qukkon and worked in the mining industry. Because of this, I'm wondering if there are volunteer guide positions available for this exhibition. I can share my experiences working in the extreme cold of Qukkon. Again, I would be thankful if you could tell me about the availability of volunteer positions as a guide.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요약으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 필자는 Qukkon Gold Rush 전시회의 수집품이 부족하다고 불만을 제기하고 있다.
필자는 Lambsford History Foundation에 기부금을 내고 싶다고 밝히고 있다.
필자는 과거 광업 경험을 살려 전시회 자원봉사 안내원에 지원하고 있다.
필자는 Qukkon의 극한 추위로 인해 광업을 그만둔 사연을 전하고 있다.

det.korean: 전시회 방문 → 과거 경험 상기 → 자원봉사 안내원 지원.
det.analysis: ✅ ③과거 경험 + 자원봉사 지원: 글 전체의 정확한 요약. ❌ ①불만 제기: 언급 없음. ❌ ②기부금: 언급 없음. ❌ ④그만둔 사연: 그만둔 이유 언급 없음.
